scope: The main Château de Hautefort as seen in August 2013, including the limestone wings, open court, main house, drawbridge gate, major round towers with slate domes and copper lanterns, and the court balustrade.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The Ministry of Culture record describes the U-shaped palace, major circular towers, grand central house and retaining terrace.
The foundation describes the two wings, Bretagne and chapel towers, open lantern domes, corner pavilions and south balustrade.
